entities.name: Canine ALDH3A1
observations: The 453-aa query exactly matches reviewed Canis lupus familiaris ALDH3A1 (UniProt A3RF36; 100% identity and coverage).
Annotated as a cytoplasmic, dimeric NADP-preferring aldehyde dehydrogenase; homolog evidence supports oxidation of aldehydes to carboxylic acids and aldehyde detoxification.
Associated biological processes include aldehyde metabolism and xenobiotic metabolism; exact physiological substrate range is not established by sequence identity alone.

entities.name: Human ALDH3A1
observations: Reviewed human ortholog P30838 aligns across the full query at 88.5% identity; annotations support cytoplasmic/cytosolic localization and aldehyde metabolic and xenobiotic metabolic processes.
